Court No. - 77
 Hon'Ble Praveen Kumar Giri, J. 
1. Heard Sri Syed Ali Imam, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Sanjay Kumar Pal, learned
counsel for opposite party No.2, and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the present application has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with the relief which has been mentioned in the prayer clause of the application.

The prayer clause is delineated below:- "It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to allow this application and quash the entire proceedings including the charge sheet dated 8.09.2013, arising out of Case No.234 of 2014, case crime no.221 of 2013, under sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad,
pending before the Civil Judge (Jr. Division)/F.T.C., I, (offences against women), Ghaziabad.

entities.text: Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Civil Judge (Jr. Division)/F.T.C., I, (offences against women), Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is further prayed that proceedings of the aforesaid case may be stayed during pendency of the present application and/or pass such other and further order as this Hon'ble court may deem just and proper under the circumstances of the present case."
3.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that both parties have entered into compromise and have settled the dispute amicably out of the Court.

4. This Court, vide order dated 4.4.2023, directed the applicants to file compromise application before the Trial Court and the concerned Court was further directed to verify the compromise application and submit a report to that effect.
The applicant was also granted liberty to file the verification order/report of the compromise before this Court.

5. Pursuant thereto, the applicants have filed the compromise application before the concerned Court and both the parties appeared before Trial Court i.e. Civil Judge (Jr. Div)/ F.T.C., Court No.1,
Ghaziabad.

entities.text:
Civil Judge (Jr. Div)/ F.T.C., Court No.1,
Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The concerned Court verified the compromise application vide report/order dated 1.5.2024 and sent a report to this Court, which is on record.

6. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 submits that the opposite party no.2 does not want to proceed with the criminal case against the applicants, and the reason has been mentioned in the compromise application.

7. Therefore, in view of the compromise arrived at between the parties, which has been duly verified by the Civil Judge (Jr. Div)/ F.T.C., Court No.1, Ghaziabad, and taking into consideration the provisions of Section 482 of Cr.P.C., this Court, in the interest of justice, deems it appropriate to exercise its inherent jurisdiction to allow the prayer made in the present application.
